affected_system: commercial curb, loading, delivery, and urban freight network
alternatives: rank verified high-consequence candidates for curb conversion and freight-access investment portfolio
select a risk-, equity-, and lifecycle-balanced portfolio for curb conversion and freight-access investment portfolio
pair multi-objective curb project prioritization with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Curb regulations, occupancy, deliveries, violations, and travel effects have consistent timestamps and locations.
Observed platform or sensor activity represents only its measured market and street coverage.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: fund only already-committed work for curb conversion and freight-access investment portfolio.

constraints.description: The urban freight and curb operations prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: curb-management director and city freight coordinator
decision_question: Which curb segments, loading technologies, and enforcement support should receive investment?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The urban freight and curb operations prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
independence_key.decision_object: curb conversion and freight-access investment portfolio
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for curb conversion and freight-access investment portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.
independence_key.primary_outcome: freight delay and safety conflict burden

intended_claim: A versioned prioritize design for comparing declared alternatives affecting curb conversion and freight-access investment portfolio, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: freight delay and safety conflict burden
distributional gap in freight delay and safety conflict burden
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not describe modeled delay or conflict reductions as realized business benefits.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for curb conversion and freight-access investment portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.

title: Prioritize curb conversion and loading investments
transportability_risks: Delivery markets, curb law, enforcement, land use, vehicle mix, and sensor coverage differ.
Platform data may omit independent carriers and informal loading behavior.
